Default ordinary BLOSUM62 tblastn per-match redo. Vec lists represent source linked-list head-to-tail order; preserve original recursive mergesort and its right-before-left exact ties, window join direction, pruning and output order. Arc<T> context replaces opaque non-owning/shallow-copied context pointers with shared ownership; this avoids freeing input traceback when temporary windows are dropped. Rust-owned buffers/typed references and RAII replace raw allocation/free; Rust OOM behavior replaces C allocation-error returns. SequenceData owns sentinel-padded storage with explicit data_offset/length and logical data()/data_mut() views; helper from_sequence constructs this representation. Context-specific callback state is held by trait implementation rather than void pointers. Matrix/sequence local_data and gapping opaque state move to explicit fields and callback object; scalar field values retain source correspondence. Smith-Waterman new_xdrop_align callback is outside default path and not exposed.
